messages:
maria_marketing: OK team — T-18h before announce. Quick sync on changelog links, docs anchors, canary timing, and webinar CTA routing. Can everyone confirm their handoffs?

josh_eng: I can push final changelog PR in ~30m. Will include the short bullet list + migration note. link: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/5421

emily_prod: Thanks. Maria — final benchmark narrative lives in the drive doc (Benchmark v3). I'll paste the TL;DR in a second for the release post. Need to confirm the lead magnets for webinar registration.

maria_marketing: Perfect. For the post we want: 1) performance bullet (latency/cost), 2) migration note for Dedicated users, 3) link to docs + changelog, 4) webinar CTA. Keep it snappy.

josh_eng: Changelog will have sections: "What changed", "Migration steps", "Known issues", "Rollout schedule". I will add anchor IDs so marketing can deep-link to the migration steps. Example slug: #migration-dedicated-2026-03

emily_prod: Maria, can you confirm which docs anchor you want for the "how to pin model versions" flow? We can point to /docs/serving/rollouts#pin-models or /docs/dedicated/upgrade#pinning — which is clearer?

maria_marketing: Use /docs/serving/rollouts#pin-models for the public post. Use the Dedicated page only for the dedicated email.

sam_sre: Canary window: engineering proposes 2-hour canary starting 08:00 PT tomorrow (low traffic). If deploy goes green, auto-promote to 50% after 45m, full by +2h. I will set alerts.

maria_marketing: Good — we’ll schedule the announce to go out right after canary crosses 50% (so we can say "canary healthy"). Who will flip the marketing publish?

emily_prod: I'll publish once canary hits 50%. Maria — I'll DM you the publish checklist.

josh_eng: Deployed artifacts: changelog PR linked above, release tag: v2.7.0-2026-03-18, release notes draft: https://docs.google.com/draft/ReleaseNotes_v2.7.0. I’ll add the kernel/quantization bullet for the performance note.

maria_marketing: For inbound lead routing — we want registrants to tag "product_interest: embeddings" or "dedicated" in the form. Emily, please confirm webhook to Intercom -> routing rule.

emily_prod: Confirmed. Webhook set: /webhooks/marketing/registrations -> intercom. Routing rule will tag and assign to AE queue "dedicated_inbound" for any box checked for "Dedicated".

sam_sre: Quick note: temporary traffic-shed policy in place if latency spikes during canary. Auto-fallback to smaller quantized model for 10% of requests. Ops will watch the traces.

maria_marketing: Copy. For the social post, short headline + a link to the TL;DR benchmark thread and a registration CTA. Josh — can you export the 99th/median numbers as a small table we can include?

josh_eng: Yes — exporting now. Will post a small CSV here in ~10m.

emily_prod: Webinar: 1pm PT next Wed. Landing page is ready at https://redwood.ai/webinar/serve-scale. Maria: do we want a secondary CTA to the docs for self-serve users?

maria_marketing: Yes — primary CTA = Register for webinar, secondary = Read docs (serving/rollouts). Include a short clip of the benchmark graph in the post assets.

deploy-bot: Canaries scheduled: release/v2.7.0 -> canary nodes @ 2026-03-19T08:00:00-07:00. Notifications will be posted here.

emily_prod: Last check: Maria, are we gating the press embargo?

maria_marketing: No embargo this time — open publish once canary 50% passes. Emily, please coordinate with sales for the AE outreach (we promised a heads-up email to top 50 accounts).

emily_prod: Will do. Sending target list to sales ops now.

josh_eng: FYI added short snippet to changelog PR with the exact doc anchors: /docs/serving/rollouts#pin-models and /docs/serving/cache#kv-prefix-caching. That should let marketing deep-link to both.

maria_marketing: Awesome. Any blockers?

sam_sre: Nothing blocking from SRE. I’ll post live metrics channel 10m before canary and watch the usual traces.

emily_prod: All good from product.

maria_marketing: Great — checklist: changelog PR merged (josh), docs anchor links confirmed (josh), webinar landing + registration routing (emily), canary schedule + alerts (sam), post assets (maria). Back up if anything slips. :thumbsup:
